key.name: monitor-layout
key.description: JSON-encoded monitor arrangement including position, resolution, physical dimensions, and DPI overrides for each display.

key.name: enabled
key.description: When enabled, the daemon applies DPI-aware scaling to cursor movement at monitor boundaries. When disabled, raw movement passes through unmodified.

key.name: auto-start
key.description: When enabled, the DuaScreenAligner daemon is started via systemd on user login.

key.name: input-device
key.description: The evdev device path for the physical mouse to intercept (e.g., /dev/input/event5). Leave empty for automatic detection.

key.name: image-source
key.description: The image source used by the preview and wallpaper exporter. Built-in values are panorama, city, desert-coast, or local.

key.name: image-local-path
key.description: Absolute file path to a user-selected local image for preview and wallpaper export.

key.name: open-overlay-request
key.description: Incremented by the preferences UI to request opening the on-screen editor overlay.

key.name: log-level
key.description: Controls the verbosity of daemon log output. Valid values: error, warn, info, debug.

key.name: label-size
key.description: Specifies the font size (in pixels) for the measurement labels displayed on screen borders.

key.name: overlay-transparency
key.description: Specifies the transparency level (0-100) for the measurement overlay. 0 is fully transparent, 100 is fully opaque.
